legend: Given an array a$$$a$$$ with n$$$n$$$ elements, n=4p,0≤p≤10,−109≤ai≤109$$$n = 4^p, 0 \le p \le 10, -10^9 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$, you can perform the following operation.

2. Divide a$$$a$$$ into 4k$$$4^k$$$ consecutive segments of length 4p−k$$$4^{p - k}$$$.
